nodes.name: Feedback webhook
nodes.notes: POST { message, email?, consent, page } from an EngineVerse form. CORS is restricted to the origins above.

nodes.name: Validate and sanitise
nodes.notes: Consent-gated contact details, bounded text, explainable categories.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO feedback_events
                  (occurred_at, category, message, contact, consent, page, dedupe_key)
                VALUES (now(), $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
                ON CONFLICT (dedupe_key) DO NOTHING

nodes.name: Store feedback (optional)
nodes.notes: Disabled until an operator creates the table and picks a retention period. The unique dedupe_key makes a double submit harmless.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, category: $json.category, message: 'Thank you - your feedback was received.' }) }}

nodes.name: Acknowledgement
nodes.notes: Same-origin POSTs from EngineVerse also need CORS on this node.
